note: Curated, credible sources for Straatpreneur's niche. gather-sources.mjs pulls these into a dated research dossier every week. Feeds map to the five sections. Only add sources that are primary (government, agency, official programme) or established journalism with a track record. Never draft a number from an aggregator or content farm.

sources.name: National Treasury: OCPO and tender bulletins
sources.notes: Procurement regulations, 30-day payment reports, budget review annexures.

sources.name: eTenders national portal (awarded)
sources.notes: Awarded tenders. Primary evidence for The Ledger award items.

sources.name: Auditor-General of South Africa: news
sources.notes: Irregular expenditure and material irregularity findings.

sources.name: South African Government news (gov.za)
sources.notes: Ministerial announcements: DSBD, dtic, new funds and programmes.

sources.name: SEDFA (Small Enterprise Development and Finance Agency)
sources.notes: Merged SEFA/SEDA. Loan products, TREP, Peo Pele implementation.

sources.name: NYDA (National Youth Development Agency)
sources.notes: Grant programme criteria and amounts.

sources.name: IDC (Industrial Development Corporation)
sources.notes: Gro-E Youth and sector funding.

sources.name: TIA (Technology Innovation Agency)
sources.notes: Seed Fund and commercialisation.

sources.name: SAB Foundation news
sources.notes: Social Innovation Awards, Tholoana, university seed funds. Winner announcements.
